pack: Puppet Master Usage redesign: official provider marks (Jared 2026-10-02: "yes use the real provider logos")
rebuild: cd ~/PM-Experiments/usage-redesign-20261001/marks-work && node tools/build.mjs && node tools/pm-emit.mjs (headless Chrome; build.mjs is AAC marks-v2 tools/build.mjs with only the variant list and paths changed; writes out/ and tools/measure.json, then marks/out, marks/sources.json and src/js/06-marks.js here). Downloaded originals are kept in marks-work/src and marks-work/dl.
rules: Official artwork only. No recolouring, redrawing or geometry changes. SVG edits are limited to dropping the XML prolog and editor comments, setting the root viewBox/width/height (the crop), and, for lockups, dropping wordmark elements that lie wholly outside the crop (each verified pixel-identical). Optical scale is metadata only.
opticalScaleMethod: inkBox = alpha-weighted share of a square box covered by the mark when contained in it (measured at 512px). scale = (min inkBox / inkBox) ^ 0.25, rounded to 0.01; render at box * scale. Platform glyphs are normalised among themselves. PM pack: the reference inkBox stays AAC's (Meta symbol, 0.2907) so every copied AAC scale is unchanged; a new mark lighter than the reference clamps to 1 (Grok, MiniMax, Vertex AI). App-icon plates use AAC's plate value 0.9.
